description: This file defines an 'Encryption' class providing methods for encrypting and decrypting messages, converting between ASCII and binary, URL-safe base64 encoding/decoding, and simple XOR-based encryption. It is part of the vtiger CRM project.

classes.name: Encryption
classes.description: A class providing encryption, decryption, and encoding utilities with methods for ASCII/binary conversion, XOR encryption, and URL-safe base64 encoding.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a message by converting to binary, XOR-ing, and URL-safe base64 encoding.

methods.name: asc2bin
methods.description: Converts an ASCII string to binary representation.

methods.name: bin2asc
methods.description: Converts binary string back to ASCII.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a message by URL-safe base64 decoding, XOR-ing, and converting from binary to ASCII.

methods.name: xor_string
methods.description: Applies XOR between each byte of string and 255.

methods.name: x_Encrypt
methods.description: Performs XOR encryption with a key.

methods.name: x_Decrypt
methods.description: Performs XOR decryption with a key, analogous to encryption.
